findings.highlight: learn how to move his body properly
findings.evidenceJa: 自身を巧く動かす思考を組み込むだけ
findings.governingReading: install the mode of thought that will move his body effectively
findings.explanation: Saber describes fitting an operative mental pattern into an already built body; the English reduces this to ordinary physical learning.

findings.evidenceJa: わたしは悲しかったなー
findings.explanation: Taiga’s recollection of how she felt when Shirou quit becomes present sadness.

findings.evidenceJa: がじがじと煎餅をかみ砕く
findings.governingReading: gnaws and crunches through the rice cracker
findings.explanation: Taiga’s forceful, sulky chewing is softened into delicate nibbling.

findings.highlight: I have a bad feeling about this
findings.evidenceJa: やな予感がするというか、未来予知というか
findings.governingReading: It is less a bad feeling than precognition
findings.explanation: Shirou’s joke that Taiga’s routine is predictable enough to constitute foresight disappears.

findings.highlight: he was pretty good in archery
findings.evidenceJa: 弓道はちょっと、この子大丈夫なのかなーって思うぐらいだった
findings.governingReading: his archery was good enough to make me wonder if this kid was even normal
findings.explanation: Taiga’s hyperbolic amazement at Shirou’s archery is reduced to mild competence.

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=セイバー char=5]百万の軍勢という味方を得て
findings.governingReading: gaining an ally described in writing as “an army of a million” but read as “Saber”
findings.explanation: The text-reading joke equating Saber alone with a million troops becomes generic reinforcements.

findings.highlight: I’ll carry out my original intention of resting my body
findings.evidenceJa: 初志貫徹はいい言葉だ
findings.governingReading: “Carry through your original intention” is a fine saying
findings.explanation: Shirou’s mock-proverbial self-justification is converted into a literal plan and adds the earlier bodily-rest purpose.

findings.highlight: Shirou’s been trying to be a superhero since then
findings.evidenceJa: その時から士郎は正義の味方だった
findings.governingReading: Shirou was a hero of justice from that time
findings.explanation: Taiga identifies childhood Shirou as already embodying the role; the English recasts this as an unfulfilled attempt.

findings.highlight: Why do you try to be a superhero?
findings.evidenceJa: なぜシロウは正義の味方なのですか？
findings.governingReading: Why is Shirou a hero of justice?
findings.explanation: Saber asks about the basis of Shirou’s existing identity; the English asks why he attempts to acquire it, changing the self-inquiry’s premise.

findings.highlight: He died peacefully because of a simple statement I made
findings.evidenceJa: なんでもない自分の一言で、安心したと遺して逝った
findings.governingReading: At one ordinary remark from me, he died leaving behind the words that he was relieved
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu saying he could die relieved is changed into Shirou’s remark causing a peaceful death, overstating causality and altering the final exchange.

findings.evidenceJa: こみ上げてくる吐き気
findings.explanation: The bodily motion of nausea rising is replaced with unnatural adversarial wording.
Shirou’s active attempt to suppress the headache becomes passive endurance.

findings.evidenceJa: いまだ胸に残っている
findings.explanation: The question’s emotional persistence in Shirou’s chest becomes cerebral storage.

findings.highlight: if she had asked me why I admired them
findings.evidenceJa: どうして憧れたのか、と問われた時
findings.governingReading: when I was asked why I came to admire it
findings.explanation: Saber’s question, which has already occurred and triggered his flight, is recast as an unrealized hypothetical.

findings.highlight: Even though I’ve been attacked with the fact that it’s meaningless, I’ve continued to do whatever I could
findings.evidenceJa: 無駄と思い知らされながらも出来る事をやってきた
findings.governingReading: Even while being forced to recognize its futility, I kept doing what I could
findings.explanation: A central statement of persistence despite disillusionment is rendered in malformed English.

findings.highlight: Thinking that it’s good enough if one person is saved by my actions
findings.evidenceJa: それで一人でも助かるのならと
findings.governingReading: in the hope that even one person might thereby be saved
findings.explanation: The English adds personal satisfaction with a minimal result; the source states the reason he continues despite futility.

findings.highlight: if I don’t accept the loss
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=じぶん]心が負けを認めないのなら
findings.governingReading: if my heart—my self—refuses to acknowledge defeat
findings.explanation: The written heart/read self identification tying Shirou’s identity to refusal of defeat disappears.
